latin: Praxis est operatio alterius potentiae ab intellectu, apta nata conformiter elici rationi rectae ad hoc: ut sit recta.
translation: Praxis is an operation of a power other than the intellect, naturally fitted to be drawn out in conformity with right reason, precisely so that it may itself be right.
